name: loadbalancer-investigate
excerpts: investigate the discord thread about /api/lookup requests on shard 7 — only some replicas are picking up traffic when telemetry shows multiple replicas configured for the cluster

querying Lighthouse trace data for the shard 7 /api/lookup spans — most Cluster.Dispatch spans show ~12s latency suggesting replica timeouts; need to see the full span tree per trace to know which replicas were tried
for each request the dispatcher fires 2-3 parallel hedge calls but only 2 actual Replica.Send invocations reach replicas; the rest fail instantly in ~50us because NextReplica() returns no candidate
reading routing/clusters.go and protocol/request.go around the ReplicasCount and NextReplica paths to understand how the executor advances through the replica list and what filter rejects a candidate
checking protocol/defaults.go and the RegionMatch + checkReplicaHealthGate to see if the health filter is silently culling otherwise-healthy replicas from the /api/lookup hedge

reading routing/dispatch.go for the retry+hedge composition; the second hedge often hits an empty pool while the first is still in flight because the hedge fires before NextReplica has rotated the cursor
wrap-up: 2-3 hedges per Dispatch but only 2 sends reach replicas; 1-2 hedges short-circuit on EmptyReplicaPool because hedge timing exhausts the available pool before the retry backoff window opens
reference_summary: Diagnosed why vortex-router's /api/lookup on shard 7 only fans out to 2 of the configured replicas: Lighthouse traces showed the dispatcher firing 2-3 parallel hedges per Cluster.Dispatch but most short-circuiting in NextReplica() with EmptyReplicaPool. Read clusters.go, protocol/request.go and routing/dispatch.go and pinned the cause to the hedge policy racing the retry/ReplicasCount rotation faster than backoff opens new candidates.
notes: Synthetic fixture inspired by a real upstream-selection investigation. Names (vortex-router, Lighthouse, shard 7) are invented.
